Variable binding accepts either reference mode at a fresh variable; unpack requires an owned reference, declared class/field shape, exhaustive Transfer and fresh distinct destinations, then removes the container. Unchanged target passages were relocated by exact-byte comparison; revised invariant passages and new links were reviewed directly. All added conceptual links point backward after moving Shared pending-liveness immediately after ordinary liveness.
limitations: Author editorial self-review. Extraction and byte ranges do not establish clarity by themselves. Earlier unchanged passages retain the prior review after exact-input comparison. Future notes remain nonnormative.
